description: Defines the PIMLeftMenuService class responsible for generating and managing the left menu in the PIM module of the OrangeHRM system. Implements methods for retrieving, caching, and permission-checking menu items for employee profiles, with various associated traits and dependencies.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuService
classes.description: Service class responsible for generating the left menu items for the employee profile interface, handling caching, permissions, and menu configuration for the PIM module.

methods.name: getEmployeeService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of EmployeeService.

methods.name: setEmployeeService
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeService instance to be used.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves the menu items for a given employee, using cache when possible.

methods.name: clearCachedMenu
methods.description: Clears the cached menu for a specific employee or all employees.

methods.name: isPimAccessible
methods.description: Determines whether the PIM menu is accessible for a given employee.

methods.name: generateMenuItems
methods.description: Generates menu items based on user permissions and employee state for the specified employee.

methods.name: isEmployeeWorkflowActionsAllowed
methods.description: Checks if workflow actions are permitted for the employee.

methods.name: getMenuFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves the menu cache for a specific employee.

methods.name: saveMenuInCache
methods.description: Stores menu items in cache for a specific employee.

methods.name: getAvailableActions
methods.description: Returns the list of available menu actions, filtered based on configuration.

methods.name: isTaxMenuEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the tax menu feature is enabled, caching the result.

methods.name: getPreparedMenuItems
methods.description: Prepares the menu items with URLs and active states for frontend rendering.
